title: Predicting Public Health Impacts of Electricity Usage
abstract: arXiv:2511.22031v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The electric power sector is a leading source of air pollutant emissions, impacting the public health of nearly every community. Although regulatory measures have reduced air pollutants, fossil fuels remain a significant component of the energy supply, highlighting the need for more advanced demand-side approaches to reduce the public health impacts. To enable health-informed demand-side management, we introduce HealthPredictor, a domain-specific AI model that provides an end-to-end pipeline linking electricity use to public health outcomes. The model comprises three components: a fuel mix predictor that estimates the contribution of different generation sources, an air quality converter that models pollutant emissions and atmospheric dispersion, and a health impact assessor that translates resulting pollutant changes into monetized health damages. translated_title: 预测电力使用对公共健康的影响
translated_abstract: 电力部门是空气污染物排放的主要来源，影响着几乎每个社区的公共健康。尽管监管措施已经减少了空气污染物，但化石燃料仍然是能源供应的重要组成部分，这凸显了需要更先进的需求侧方法来减少公共健康影响。为了实现基于健康信息的需求侧管理，我们引入了HealthPredictor，这是一个特定领域的AI模型，提供了将电力使用与公共健康结果联系起来的端到端流程。该模型包含三个组件：燃料组合预测器（估计不同发电来源的贡献）、空气质量转换器（模拟污染物排放和大气扩散）以及健康影响评估器（将由此产生的污染物变化转化为货币化的健康损害）。在美国多个地区，我们的健康驱动优化框架……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了HealthPredictor——一个将电力使用与公共健康结果联系起来的端到端AI模型，通过燃料组合预测、空气质量模拟和货币化健康损害评估三个组件，实现基于健康信息的需求侧电力管理。
en_tdlr: HealthPredictor, a domain-specific AI model providing an end-to-end pipeline linking electricity use to public health outcomes through fuel mix prediction, air quality modeling, and monetized health damage assessment, enabling health-informed demand-side power management.
